name: Michael Sawyer
org: BIND 9 development team (Internet Software Consortium / ISC)
why_notable: Credited as the second original author of dig: he rewrote it for the ground-up BIND 9 rewrite around 2000, building on BIND 9's libraries. His rewrite allowed several lookups on one command line, added batch mode and a cleaner query-option (+flag) syntax, and supported EDNS. That code is the basis of the dig that ships today in dnsutils/bind-utils on Linux, BSD and macOS.
